name: optical-design
description: Optical calculations, sequential lens workflows, and engineering review.

interface.shortDescription: From a first lens to an engineering review
interface.longDescription: Calculate optical limits, inspect and improve supported sequential lens models, validate explicit requirements, and create review packages. Portable examples work without an OpticStudio license. Python and uv are needed for computation; native analysis needs licensed OpticStudio on Windows.
defaultPrompt: Walk me through the bundled portable lens example.
Inspect my saved lens and help define requirements.
Review my optical results and explain their limits.
